scope: Stress exploration requested by user: 4–32 GiB budgets, including above normal GPU headroom. Requested budget may exceed actual allocation or fail.
guards: No minimum free-GPU guard for this stress sweep; per-run wall limit 180 s and system available-RAM floor 2 GiB. Existing OS memory settings are unchanged.

tasks.prompt: Explain to a student how conservation of energy applies to a ball thrown upward. Discuss kinetic energy, gravitational potential energy, air resistance, and why the speed changes. Give examples and identify common misconceptions.

Explain a systematic process for finding an off-by-one error in a loop that traverses a list. Include examples, boundary cases, a loop invariant, and how to check the proposed repair without relying only on random tests.

selection: Stress results do not automatically qualify for recommendation; normal 512 MiB GPU / 3 GiB RAM headroom rules still apply.
